tei:div.tei:p: ༁ྃ: zab chos zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol las/ bskyed rim lhan thabs 'dzab dgongs grags stong tshangs dbyangs bzlas tshad rang grol bzhugs so//

zhi khro rtsa gsum lha tshogs 'khor bcas la// phyag 'tshal de yi 'dzab dgongs rim pa bri// zab chos zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol las// 'dzab mi gsal bas deng sang phyag len du// btags grol snying pos bsnyen sgrub las gsum bzhed// de tsam rgyas drags mi lcogs rang gzhung ni// rtsa sgrub phyi nang mang yang dbang bzhi yi// sngon 'gro zhi khro'i spyi dril bzlas pa 'byung*// sgom rim lhan skyes rang grol de ltar dang*// bskang bshags de sham yig brgya bshags pa sogs// zhi khro'i rang gzhung gzhan 'ga' dang bstun nas// gang yang mi 'gal 'thad 'os gsum bya'o// de la rgyas dang 'bring dang bsdus pa'o/ dang po rgyas pa ltar na bdun bya ste/ 'dzab kha dbye ba dang*/ 'dzab la bskul ba dang*/ 'dzab dmigs ting nge 'dzin dang*/ 'dzab dngos bgrangs pa dang*/ 'dzab sham bsgyur ba dang*/ 'dzab bstod bya ba dang*/ 'dzab mtha' phrin las bcol ba'o/ dang po 'dzab kha dbye ba ni/ sgrub pa'i mched lcam thams cad kyis lus ngag yid kyi khyer so gsum dang*/ dkyil 'khor gsum ldan gyi ting nge 'dzin gyi ngang nas gyer dang dbyangs gsal rol mo dang bcas kyis dkyil 'khor bskor zhing 'di skad do/ hūm̐/ dur khrod gsang chen rol pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir// thabs shes nyi zla ma chags pad+ma'i dkyil// gtso brgyad dar zab rin chen khri steng du// dus gsum rgyal ba 'dus pa'i sku gsung thugs// bla ma yi dam rtsa gsum zhi khro'i tshogs// yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa'i cha lugs ni// 'bar ba zhi dang khro sogs gar dgur ldan// brjid pa'i sku la rang rang chas rnams rdzogs// gsung gi snying po sgra dbyangs sngags dang bcas// thugs ni sgrol gyur srog bcas ye shes sems// 'dzab kyi rgyud bskul mi g.yo sku gsung thugs// 'od zer 'phro 'dus 'gro kun sdig sgrib sbyangs// ma gsal bar du bskyed cing 'bad pas bsgom// ma 'grub bar du mi btang bsgrub par bgyi// gnyis pa 'dzab la bskul ba ni/

hūm̐/ longs sku gsal dag thig le'i gzhal yas nas// seng ge glang rta rma bya shang shang khri// 'khor lo rdo rje rin chen pad+ma dang*// rgya gram nyi zla pad+ma ge sar steng*// zhi dang khro bor ston pa'i yi dam lha// bde stong lhan skyes so so'i yum dang bcas// gar dgu'i nyams ldan sku la rgyan rnams rdzogs// 'dzab rgyun gsung mchog chos kyi sgra dbyangs sgrogs// 'pho 'gyur med pa'i thugs mchog ye shes sems// yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs 'khor bcas la// phyag 'tshal mchod bstod dbang dang dngos grub stsol// oṃ gyis spros pas stong gsum sku yis gang*// āḥyis bskul bas sngags dbyangs 'dzab sgra sgrogs// hūm̐ gis dmigs pas mi g.yo ting 'dzin brtan// sku gsung thugs mchog yi dam zhi khro'i lha// ma gsal bar du bskyed cing 'bad pas bsgom// ma 'grub bar du dgongs pa mi btang ngo*// gsum pa 'dzab kyi dmigs pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ phal cher sgrub pa chen po bsngags pa las/ 'gro drug gi sdug bsngal so sor sbyong ba la/ dper na rgyal po'i pho nya 'gyed pa lta bu ste/ bdag nyid lha yi thugs ka'i sa bon las sngags kyi 'od zer dpag tu med pa dmyal ba'i gnas su 'phros pas/ de'i byin rlabs kyis dmyal ba btso bsreg la sogs pa'i tsha grang gi sdug bsngal thams cad zhi zhing sdig sgrib ma lus pa byang nas/ zhi khro rtsa ba gsum gyi rang bzhin du gyur nas rin po che'i gzhal yas khang yangs shing rgya che bar sngags sgra di ri ri sgrogs par bsam/ 'dzab rgyun ma chad par bya'o/ de'i 'gres so/ bdag nyid lha yi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pa'i byin rlabs kyis yi dwags bkres skom/ dud 'gro blun rmongs/ mi skye rga na 'chi/ lha ma yin 'thab rtsod/ lha ltung ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad zhi zhing*/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa ma lus pa byang nas zhi khro rtsa ba gsum gyi sku 'ba' zhig tu gyur te/

rin po che sna tshogs kyi gzhal yas khang yangs shing rgya che bar sngags sgra di ri ri sgrogs par bsam la 'dzab bzla'o/ bzhi pa 'dzab sngags dngos ni/ rgyas par zhi khro yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa'i snying po las/ dang po zhi ba yab yum 'khor bcas ni/ hūm̐ badz+ra tsit+ta āḥ badz+ra sa man+ta bha dra oṃ: oṃ dzi na dzika: lāṃ te shwa ra ti s+t+waṃ: hūm̐ badz+ra dhṛka: mūṃ dha tu shwa ri s+t+waṃ: swā rat+na dhṛka: māṃ mo ha ra ti s+t+waṃ: am̐ a ro lika: pāṃ rā ga ra ti s+t+waṃ: ha pradz+nyā ḍhṛka: tāṃ badz+ra ra ti s+t+waṃ: k+ṣi hi rā tsa ya swā hā: mai tri dhā ra ni swā hā: hūm̐ swā ra tsa ya swā hā: trāṃ a gar+bha ya swā hā: hrī ha hūm̐ pad+ma bha ta ma swā hā: mūṃ shrī a raṃ gha ya swā hā: thiṃlha sa raṃ pa ya swā hā: dzhiṃ ku ru pa ṇi hrīḥswā hā: hūm̐ lā s+ye sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: hūm̐ puṣ+pe a be sha ya s+t+waṃ: trāṃ mā l+ye sa ma ya hoḥ dzaḥdhu pe pra be sha ya s+t+waṃ: hrīḥgīrti ra ga ya hoḥ bam̐ dī paṃ su ki ni sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: hoḥgan+dhe tsit+ta ya hoḥ a nīrti rā ga ya mi s+t+waṃ: oṃ mu ne kreṃ swā hā: oṃ mu ne breṃ swā hā: oṃ mu ne truṃ swā hā: oṃ mu ne k+ṣaṃ swā hā: oṃ mu ne sruṃ swā hā: oṃ mu ne ye swā hā: oṃ badz+ra kro ta bi dza ya hūm̐: badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra kro ta ya man+ta ka hūm̐: badz+ra pā sha hūm̐: oṃ pad+ma kro ta h+ya grī wa hūm̐: badz+ra s+pho ṭa bam̐: oṃ badz+ra kro ta a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūm̐: badz+ra gaṇ+ḍe hoḥ de yan chad zhi bar bsnyen pa'i snying po'o/ de nas khro bo bsgrub pa'i snying po ni/ oṃ ma hā kro ta ma hā shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ma hā kro ti shwa ri s+t+waṃ: oṃ bud+dha kro ta ma hā shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭaḥ bud+dha kro ti shwa ri s+t+waṃ: oṃ badz+ra kro ta ma hā shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭaḥ badz+ra kro ti shwa ri s+t+waṃ: oṃ rat+na kro ta ma hā shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭaḥ

rat+na kro ti shwa ri s+t+waṃ: oṃ pad+ma kro ta ma hā shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭaḥ pad+ma kro ti shwa ri s+t+waṃ: oṃ karma kro ta ma hā shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭaḥ karma kro ti shwa ri s+t+waṃ: oṃ badz+ra kau rī ha: oṃ badz+ra tsau rī ha: oṃ badz+ra pra mo hā ha: oṃ badz+ra bā+ai ta lī ha: oṃ badz+ra puska sī ha: oṃ badz+ra ghasma rī ha: oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa lī ha: oṃ badz+ra sme sha nī ha: oṃ badz+ra sengha mu kha he: oṃ badz+ra byā kri mu kha he: oṃ badz+ra sri la mu kha he: oṃ badz+ra shwa na mu kha he: oṃ badz+ra kṛ ta mu kha he: oṃ badz+ra kaṅka mu kha he: oṃ badz+ra kha khwa mu kha he: oṃ badz+ra hu lu mu kha he: oṃ badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐: oṃ badz+ra s+pho ṭa bam̐: oṃ badz+ra gaṇ+ḍe hoḥ oṃ ma nu rak+sha sī bh+yoḥ brah+ma ṇī bh+yoḥ ro'u tri ma bh+yoḥ bha na bhe bh+yoḥ ku ma rī bh+yoḥ in+ḍa ya ni bh+yoḥ singha ka la ni bh+yoḥ a mṛ taṃ bh+yoḥ se'u ni bh+yoḥ ta na haṃ bh+yoḥ rak+sha si bh+yoḥ bak+sha si bh+yoḥ ra tri ma bh+yoḥ ra tri re ma ti bh+yoḥ e ka tsa ra ma bh+yoḥ ma nu ha ra ma bh+yoḥ si ti kaṃ bh+yoḥ bha ya bhe bh+yoḥ ma hā ma rā ṇa bh+yoḥ ag+ne ye bh+yoḥ bha ra hī bh+yoḥ tsa mun+t+ri bh+yoḥ bhu ta na bh+yoḥ pā ṇi badz+ra bh+yoḥ ma hā kā lī bh+yoḥ tsa kā la badz+ra bh+yoḥ badz+ra bum+pa ka ra ṇa bh+yoḥ badz+ra lam+bo dha ra ṇa bh+yoḥ de yan chad khro bor bsgrub pa'i snying po'o/ lnga pa 'dzab kha bsgyur ba ni/ nad gdon 'jigs brgyad shin+taṃ ku ru ye swā hā: tshe bsod dpal 'byor puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: 'khor 'das srid gsum wa shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: gnod byed dgra bgegs mā ra ya phaṭaḥ 'dod gsol dang*/ a ā sogs ā li dang*/ ka kha ga gha nga sogs kā li dang*/ oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya sogs yig brgya dang*/ oṃ ye dharma sogs rten snying rnams lan gsum gyis kha bskang bar bya'o/ drug pa 'dzab bstod bya ba ni/ spos dang rol mos gzi byin bskyed la/

hūm̐/ bla ma yi dam zhi khro 'khor dang bcas// ye shes lha tshogs spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// 'jig rten srung ma pho mo dam la 'dus// phyi nang gsang ba'i 'dzab bsnyen mchod pa 'bul// gzhal yas khang chen 'di la byin phobs la// sgrub rdzas gnyan po 'di la bcud cig phob// snang gsal mar me 'di la bkrag mdangs bskyed// sgrub mchog mos pa'i bu la byin gyis rlobs// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub da stsol cig /bgegs dang log 'dren 'byung po rdul du rlogs// phyi nang rkyen ngan bar chad bsal du gsol// bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi// ci bsam don 'bras chos bzhin 'grub par mdzod// sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las kyi// nyams chag 'gal 'khrul ci mchis mthol zhing bshags// lus ngag yid la nongs par ma gyur cig /bdun pa 'dzab mtha' phrin las bcol ba ni/ hūm̐/ zhi ba lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor nas// bla ma rig 'dzin bde gshegs zhi ba'i lha// khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas// yi dam zhi khro khrag 'thung 'bar ba'i lha// yab yum sras dang 'khor dang bka' srung bcas// thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod// phrin las rnam bzhi'i dngos grub stsal du gsol// gnas skabs mthun rkyen dngos grub char ltar phobs/ kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sarba sid+dhi pha la ho/ zhes dngos grub bskul ba'o/ de ltar rim pa ni rgyas pa'i lugs so/ sngar bka' ma'i rjes su 'brangs nas thun mgor gsol 'debs/ thun mjug mchod bstod sogs snang yang*/ gter ma nang mthun pa 'di dag go /yang 'dzab dgongs 'bring po'i lugs la bdun te/ 'dzab kha dbye ba dang*/ 'dzab bskul dang*/ 'dzab dmigs dang*/ 'dzab dngos dang*/ 'dzab kha bsgyur ba dang*/ 'dzab bstod dang*/ dngos grub bskul ba'o/ dang po ni/ thams cad kyang lus ngag yid gsum khyer so gsum dang dkyil 'khor rnam pa gsum ldan gyi ngang nas gyer dbyangs rol mor bcas te 'di skad do/

hūm̐/ bskul lo bskul lo thugs dam gnad nas bskul// bzhengs shig bzhengs shig chos kyi dbyings nas bzhengs// sku ni gar bsgyur rdzu 'phrul glog ltar 'khyug /gsung ni chos sgra 'dzab dbyangs 'brug ltar sgrogs// thugs rje brtse bas sgrub mchog rnams la dgongs// 'dzab kyi rgyud bskul rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs// bla ma yi dam zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor lha// 'khor bcas gnad nas bskul lo 'dzab sgra sgrogs// byin chen dbab pa'i dus la da bab pas// thugs dam dbyings nas bskul lo bzhengs su gsol// sngags kyi glu gar rol mo da mdzod la// ye shes lha tshogs 'grub par mdzad du gsol// gnyis pa ni/ hūm̐/ zhi khro 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po nas// sna tshogs dar zab rin chen brtsegs pa'i khri// thabs dang shes rab nyi zla 'od kyi dkyil// chags bral pad+ma 'bar ba'i ge sar la// bde gshegs dgongs pa yongs rdzogs grub pa'i dpal// rgyal ba zhi khro yab yum sras 'khor bcas// brjid pa'i sku la rang rang chas rnams rdzogs// 'dzab kyis rgyud bskul rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs// 'od zer 'phro 'dus 'gro kun sdig sgrib sbyangs// ma gsal bar du bskyed cing 'bad pas bsgom// ma 'grub bar du ting 'dzin mi btang ngo*// gsum pa ni/ stong khams thams cad 'dzab sngags kyi chos sgras gang ba dper na bung ba tshang zhig pa lta bu ste/ 'di ni phal cher dbang rgyas bsdus la bsngags so/ bdag nyid lha yi thugs ka'i sa bon las sngags kyi 'od zer dpag tu med pa brjod kyis mi lang ba steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad du 'phros shing khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad la phog pas/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib ma lus pa byang zhing dag nas thams cad dus gcig la bla ma yi dam rgyal ba zhi khro rab 'byams kyi sku sha stag tu gyur te/ de rnams kyis 'dzab sngags di ri ri sgrog par bsam la/

'dzab sngags rgyun chad med pa sgrog par bya'o/ bzhi pa ni/ oṃ ā li kā li dz+nyā na pañtsa satwa kro ta mu ne ye swā hā: oṃ bho dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dz+nyā na dhā tu āḥ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: zhi khro dam pa rigs brgya'i yang snying mi tshig gis bar ma chod par dbyangs dang bcas pas bsgrang ngo*/ lnga pa ni/ spyir rtsa sngags sham du/ zhi ba la shin+taṃ/ rgyas par puṣ+ṭiṃ/ dbang la wā shaṃ/ drag por mā ra ya phaṭaḥ lhun grub la bzhi ka bsdom pa dang*/ khyad par ni dbang rgyas 'bring bsnyen dus/ dz+nyā na kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa sid+dhi hūm̐ swā hā: gshin don bdun tshigs dus su/ oṃ ma ma ko ling sa man+ta tshe 'das che ge'i las sgrib bag chags thams cad shin+taṃ ku ru ye swā hā: na raka skong bshags dus zhi ba rigs lnga dang*/ khrag 'thung rigs lnga'i yig brgya'i mthar/ nyams chag sdig sgrib thams cad shin+taṃ ku ru ye swā hā: zhes sogs sbyar ba'o/ gang yin kyang rjes su dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten 'brel snying po 'grub pa'i smon lam dang bcas pa lan gsum du bya'o/ drug pa ni/ spos bsreg /rol mo dang bcas pas/ hūm̐/ ye shes lha tshogs spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// phyi nang gsang ba'i 'dzab bsnyen mchod pa 'bul// sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las bstod// nyams chag 'gal 'khrul ci mchis mthol lo bshags// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol// bdun pa ni/ hūm̐/ bde gshegs rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha tshogs kyis// 'gyur med sku yi dngos grub stsal du gsol// 'gag med gsung gi dngos grub stsal du gsol// 'khrul med thugs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// yon tan re skong dngos grub stsal du gsol// phrin las 'gro 'dul dngos grub stsal du gsol/ rtsa sngags dang*/ kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: zhes dngos grub blangs/ de yan chad 'bring po'i lugs so/

yang 'dzab dgongs bsdus pa ni/ hūm̐/ dngos grub mchog stsol rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs// rmad byung ting 'dzin 'dzab kyi 'phro 'du las// dgongs spyod dag pa'i ye shes rab bskul te// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol// dmigs pa ni gong ltar dang*/ 'dzab ni zhi khro rigs 'dus sbrel ma 'di'o/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dz+nyā na dhā tu āḥ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: zhes pa 'di ni brgya stong khri 'bum sogs grangs thems pa dang*/ kha bsgyur dang bstod bskul la sogs pa rnams 'phrul shes par bya'o/ spyir 'dzab kyi rnam bshad zhib rgyas dgongs 'dus la sogs gzhan du ltos/ zhi khro'i las byang la nyer mkho 'di ni man ngag bskyed rdzogs kyi lag len dang gter chos gzhan 'ga' zhig la phyogs tsam blo sbyangs pa'i sngags 'chang chos 'byung gis he brag dkar gyi dben gnas su sbyar ba re zhig dge'o/// /
